narrative.intro: Gilbane Federal has $114M in contract obligations in FY2027 to date. Obligations by fiscal year show a history of volatility: FY22 $93.4M, FY23 $455M, FY24 $184M, FY25 $91.4M, FY26 $38M, and FY27 $114M. The current-year total is partial, covering the fiscal year to date, and the figures reported are obligations except where tables note award-value totals. The FY27 activity is concentrated in a single award, which sets the current average award size equal to the reported total obligations. Readers should treat FY2027 numbers as incomplete for the full year when comparing across fiscal years.
